name: HC13 No. active on ART with confirmed Advanced HIV Disease with suppressed viral Load by the end of the reporting quarter
description: Counts unique patients who are active on ART and have a documented confirmed Advanced HIV Disease status recorded as positive TB, CD4 below 200, or WHO stage 3/4, and who also have evidence of viral-load suppression.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card",
    "mamba_fact_viral_load_episode"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE (
    (
        a.encounter_date >= :startDate
            AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        )
        OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
    )
  AND a.advanced_disease_status like  '%Confirmed Advanced Disease%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
    WHERE v.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND v.is_suppressed = 1
);",

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE (
    (
        a.encounter_date >= :startDate
            AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        )
        OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
    )
  AND a.advanced_disease_status like  '%Confirmed Advanced Disease%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
    WHERE v.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND v.is_suppressed = 1
);
